title: 云计算与 SaaS 产业结构分析
core_insight: 云计算与 SaaS 产业结构变化主要体现在技术层面的进步，包括 AI、云原生和基础设施的改进，AWS、Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 在技术层面、基础设施以及应用层方面均有显著进展

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 在云原生技术方面取得重大突破，AWS 推出了 MicroVMs，提供了新的 serverless 计算方式 Google Cloud 的 BigQuery 和 AlloyDB AI 取得重大更新，Azure Files 结合了熟悉的文件访问和内置的性能、数据保护、安全和 Azure 服务集成 Run isolated sandboxes with full lifecycle control: AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs Google is a Leader and positioned furthest in Vision and highest in Execution in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Conversational AI Platforms Frontier models and production agents: Advancing Microsoft Foundry for the agentic era Meet Brain: The AI system behind Azure reliability 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Microsoft Azure 的 External Key Management 功能进入公测阶段 Google Cloud 的 AlloyDB AI 取得重大更新，Azure IaaS 帮助组织设计、构建和优化云基础设施以实现长期成本效率 External key management for Azure Managed HSM is now in public preview How to solve PostgreSQL multilingual full-text search limitations with AlloyDB AI Azure IaaS: How to design, build, and optimize cloud infrastructure for long-term cost efficiency
dimension_texts.application: HubSpot 推出新解决方案以支持内容优化和 AI 搜索优化 HubSpot 的新解决方案支持企业数字化转型，Salesforce 强调了数据安全和信任在 AI 应用中的重要性 Best content optimization tools for ROI-focused teams What is AI search optimization? (& why marketers should care) Trust Shouldn’t Be a Product Feature. It Has to Be the Foundation.
